podcast.title: Guitar Instructor
podcast.body: Mike Treblecock, founder of the Killjoys, currently teaches guitar. "Mike Treblecock has now teaching guitar."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Horror Film Enthusiast and Filmmaker
podcast.body: A lifelong fan of horror films, Treblecock is actively involved in the genre, having directed several horror movies under the name "Spit Take Films," which are available on a YouTube channel. He has also scored films for other directors and written music for a fishing show and a comedy club. "He's been a fan since he was a kid. He's made a bunch of horror movies under the name Spit Take Films. There's a YouTube channel where you can see some of them. He's also scored movies for other people, more than it doesn't actually, and he wrote music for a fishing show and a comedy club."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Formation and Radio Presence (1992)
xref.body: The Killjoys were formed in Hamilton in 1992 by Mike Treblecock. They became a pervasive presence on rock radio and Much Music throughout the mid-1990s. "Hamilton's Killjoy's were pretty much inescapable on rock radio and on much music during the middle of the decade. They were formed in 1992 by Mike Treblecock."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
